results.answer: Lessons begin at 07:45 in the morning [S1].
If your child is late three times in one term, they will serve a Friday detention from 13:30 to 14:30 [S1]. Additionally, the class teacher will inform you in writing [S1].

Yes, learners may bring a cellphone to school for safety reasons [S1]. However, it must be switched off and handed to the class teacher at 07:45 [S1]. The phones are returned to the learners at 13:45 [S1].
You should report bullying to the grade head within 24 hours [S1].
Ten demerits in a term lead to a meeting with the principal [S1].
The annual school fee for a Grade 2 learner is R24 000 [S1].
Yes! Parents who pay the full annual fee by 31 January receive a 5 percent discount [S1].
Interest of 1.5 percent per month is charged on any amount that is more than 30 days overdue [S1].
The third and any further children from the same family enrolled at the school receive a 20 percent discount on fees [S1].

If you cannot afford the fees, you may apply for a full or partial exemption [S1]. Applications must be made using form F1 and submitted to the fees committee with proof of income [S1]. The deadline to apply is 31 March [S1].
No, trainers are only allowed for physical education lessons and sport [S1]. Learners wear black leather lace-up school shoes for regular wear [S1].
The only jewellery allowed is a watch and one pair of plain stud earrings [S1].
The second-hand uniform shop is open on Wednesdays from 07:15 to 08:00 in the school hall [S1].

When your son misses a formal test due to illness, he must bring a medical certificate or a letter from you (the parent) to his class teacher within three school days [S1]. After providing this, he will be able to write a catch-up test [S1].

To be promoted to the next grade, a learner must pass their Home Language with at least 50 percent and Mathematics with at least 40 percent [S1].
The Route A bus leaves the Hillcrest stop at 06:50 in the morning [S1].
Parents' evening is on Thursday 20 February at 17:30 in the school hall [S1].

For a learner in Grade 6, the monthly school fee instalment is R2,760 [S1]. 

The school bus service costs R650 per learner per month, which is paid together with the school fees [S2]. 

Adding these together, your total monthly payment for fees and transport is **R3,410**.

For physical education, learners wear their house T-shirt, navy shorts, and white trainers [S1]. Trainers are also allowed for sport [S3]. 

In the afternoon, the bus leaves the school at 14:10 [S2].

If your child is late for school three times in one term, they must serve a Friday detention from 13:30 to 14:30, and the class teacher will inform you in writing [S2]. 

If a learner misses a formal test without a valid reason (such as a medical certificate or a parent's letter brought to the class teacher within three school days), they will receive a mark of zero [S1].

If a learner misbehaves on the bus, they are suspended from the bus service for one week, and their parents are informed in writing [S1]. 

Bullying is considered a serious offence in any form, which includes online bullying [S2].

If the lockdown code word (BLUE KESTREL) is announced by the principal over the intercom, you should lock the classroom door, keep learners away from the windows, and wait for the all-clear [S1].

Sports day takes place on Saturday 14 March at the school field, starting at 08:30 [S1]. For the event, learners wear their house T-shirts [S1]. For physical education and sport, the required kit also includes navy shorts and white trainers [S2][S4].

No, school fees are not waived for 2027 [S2]. Annual school fees depend on the learner's grade: R18,600 for Grade R, R24,000 for Grades 1 to 3, and R27,600 for Grades 4 to 7 [S2].
